# Vespera Caviar — llms.txt

> High-end, sustainably sourced caviar house based in New York. Malossol-cured, never frozen, packed to order, and shipped overnight nationwide.
> Full Knowledge Base: https://www.vesperacaviar.com/llms-full.txt

## About
Vespera Caviar is an artisanal caviar purveyor operating directly from New York. By eliminating middleman holding times and retail storefront delays, Vespera delivers fresh, never-frozen sturgeon roe in peak condition.

## Core Offerings

| Selection | Species | Pearl Character | Profile | Canonical URL |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Siberian Sturgeon Classic** | *Acipenser baerii* | Medium, jet-black | Nutty, earthy, clean pop, mild spice finish | https://www.vesperacaviar.com/siberian |
| **Kaluga Fusion Reserve** | *Huso dauricus* × *Amur* | Large, olive-brown | Buttery, subtle sweetness, brioche, briny | https://www.vesperacaviar.com/kaluga |
| **Imperial Kaluga Fusion** | *Huso dauricus* × *Amur* (Top 5%) | Oversized, golden-amber | Intensely creamy, rich almond/walnut, Beluga-like | https://www.vesperacaviar.com/imperial |

## Standards & Quality Commitments
- **Cure**: Traditional Malossol (≤3.5%–4% pure sea salt)
- **State**: 100% Fresh — never frozen
- **Provenance**: Sustainable, CITES-certified sturgeon farms
- **Logistics**: Packed to order in New York and dispatched via temperature-controlled overnight transit (28–32°F)

## Serving & Care
- **Storage**: Refrigerate immediately at 28–32°F (-2°C to 0°C)
- **Unopened Life**: 3–4 weeks (check date stamp on tin base)
- **Opened Life**: Enjoy within 2–3 days; keep chilled on crushed ice
- **Utensils**: Mother-of-pearl, horn, bone, or gold-plated spoons (avoid reactive metals)
